name: Second Sight Dilemma
source:
What would you do if you knew that the world was ending in 24 hours?

Would you try to enjoy your remaining hours? Or would you try to uncover the truth, and maybe even save the world in the process?

[From [url=https://jeloki.itch.io/second-sight-dilemma]itch.io[/url]]
